proposal.title: Add the admin dashboard's dev origin to the API's CORS allowlist
proposal.rationale: Every admin surface (leads, schools, quality, harness-runs, llm-calls) logs a CORS preflight failure against http://localhost:8000 from origin http://localhost:5173 and ends in net::ERR_FAILED (findings.json console_errors on all 5 admin.* entries). The admin.leads.png screenshot shows the resulting broken state: a red 'No response from the backend' banner and 'Couldn't load this view / API unreachable.' api/config.py:47-53 hardcodes cors_origins to localhost:8081 (mobile) and localhost:3000 (web) but never lists localhost:5173, which is the admin dashboard's own Vite dev origin — so every admin page is unusable locally while web/mobile work fine.
proposal.change: Add "http://localhost:5173" to the default cors_origins list in api/config.py:47, alongside the existing localhost:8081/localhost:3000 entries.

proposal.title: Underline inline links in legal and consent copy
proposal.rationale: axe 'link-in-text-block' (high severity) hits register (2 elements), privacy (3), terms (4), and support (1). web.public.register.png shows exactly this: 'Terms of Service' and 'Privacy Policy' inside the signup consent sentence are distinguished from the surrounding black text only by green color, with no underline.
proposal.change: Add an underline (or other non-color affordance) to inline text links in the signup consent line and the legal-page body-copy component so links don't rely on color alone.

proposal.title: Schedule weak-spot resurfacing with spaced repetition instead of pure recency
proposal.rationale: api/routes/weak_spots.py returns a student's flagged problems ordered only by submitted_at, deduped by problem text, capped at a limit (default 20) — there is no due-date, interval, or mastery field anywhere in the module. A student who has since mastered a weak spot keeps seeing it indefinitely, while an older unresolved one can quietly fall off the list as new flags push it past the limit.
proposal.change: Add a next_review_at / retry-count field to the weak-spot record, order the Review tab by what's due today using increasing intervals after each successful retry, and drop items once the student demonstrates mastery (e.g. two consecutive clean retries).

proposal.title: Allow the admin dashboard origin in the API's CORS config
proposal.rationale: Every admin surface's console_errors show the same CORS preflight failure: 'Access to fetch at http://localhost:8000/v1/admin/... from origin http://localhost:5173 has been blocked by CORS policy: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header'. The screenshots confirm the real effect: admin.leads and admin.quality both render 'No response from the backend' / 'Couldn't load this view' / 'API UNREACHABLE' — the entire admin dashboard fails to load any data in this environment.
proposal.change: Add the admin dashboard's origin (http://localhost:5173 for local/dev, plus its deployed origin) to the API's CORS allow-list so the admin app's fetch calls to /v1/admin/* succeed; verify by reloading admin.leads and confirming the lead table renders instead of the error state.

proposal.title: Add a one-click 'Generate reteach set' action directly on the teacher-day missed-concept signal
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' and a 'path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set,' plus a separate Generation capability that turns a topic into a verified problem set. The gap: nothing described ties the two together as a single action — a teacher seeing a missed-concept signal still has to leave analytics and manually drive Generation. This stays inside the homework->grade->understand->reteach loop (no LMS features involved).
proposal.change: On the teacher-day/analytics view, add a 'Generate reteach set' button next to each flagged weak concept that pre-fills Generation's topic/source with that concept and the relevant students, so the teacher goes from signal to a ready-to-assign, verified problem set in one step instead of a manual topic re-entry.

proposal.title: Auto-suggest a targeted follow-up practice set when the integrity check returns low confidence
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md: the integrity check 'emits per-problem badges/confidence/reasoning' when a student can't explain their own work, but the described loop stops at surfacing that verdict to the teacher — there's no mention of it automatically feeding Practice. Today a teacher has to notice a low-confidence badge and separately decide to assign practice; this closes the loop the product already promises ('reteach') without auto-grading or auto-flagging anything (the teacher still approves the suggestion).
proposal.change: When an integrity check returns a low-confidence/can't-explain badge for a problem, surface a teacher-approved suggestion (not auto-assigned) on the grade-review screen: 'Assign 3 similar practice problems on this concept' using the existing Practice generation, one click to confirm.

proposal.title: Add the dashboard's dev origin to the API's CORS allowlist
proposal.rationale: Every admin surface logs identical CORS preflight failures ("blocked by CORS policy ... No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header") against http://localhost:8000 from origin http://localhost:5173, and admin.leads' screenshot shows the resulting full-page failure state ("API UNREACHABLE" / "Couldn't load this view") instead of any data. Root-caused in api/config.py:47-53: `cors_origins` only lists localhost:8081/3000 plus prod domains — localhost:5173 (the dashboard/ Vite app's default dev port) is absent, so the FastAPI CORSMiddleware (api/middleware/setup.py:30-36) rejects every browser fetch from the dashboard in local dev. This isn't an isolated flake: it reproduces identically on all 5 admin surfaces tested.
proposal.change: Add "http://localhost:5173" (the dashboard/ Vite dev server origin) to the default `cors_origins` list in api/config.py, alongside the existing localhost:8081/3000 entries.

proposal.title: Generate a short reteach mini-lesson for a class's top missed concept, not just more practice problems
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day as surfacing "which concepts the class is missing" and giving "a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set" — today that path lands on practice.py generating more of the same problem type (api/core/practice.py). There's no step that generates actual instructional content (a worked example + the 2-3 key steps students are missing) for the teacher to display or assign before more practice. This stays inside the homework->grade->understand->reteach loop and reuses the existing generation/verification machinery (assignment_generation.py already independently re-derives answers before trusting output).
proposal.change: When teacher-day analytics identifies a class-wide weak concept, add a "Generate reteach explainer" action that produces a short worked-example mini-lesson (reusing the generation engine's answer-verification pattern) for the teacher to review and present/assign, distinct from the existing "more practice problems" action.

proposal.title: Show the student a short recap of what the understanding-check conversation revealed
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md: the integrity understanding-check "probes the student to explain their own steps" and emits badges/reasoning, but the described consumer is the teacher ("you see the grade, the flag, the full conversation ... Veradic drafts, you publish"). There's no mention of the student seeing a takeaway from their own conversation — today the check is purely a teacher-facing scrutiny signal, which fits the "raises scrutiny, never auto-flags" principle, but leaves the student's own loop (the one who struggled to explain) without closure.
proposal.change: After the integrity conversation ends, show the student a short, teacher-approved-tone recap ("you had trouble explaining step 2 — here's the idea again") framed as a learning moment, not a grade or a flag — keeping the teacher as the one who sees/approves the underlying verdict.

proposal.title: Generate a teacher-facing reteach briefing from a surfaced concept gap
proposal.rationale: PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md describes teacher-day analytics surfacing 'which concepts the class is missing' with 'a path from a struggle signal to a reteach/practice set' (api/routes/teacher_practice_activity.py) — but that path only generates more drill problems for the student. There's no teacher-facing explanation of the concept itself to use live in class, which is a distinct need from student practice.
proposal.change: When teacher-day analytics surfaces a concept the class is missing, add a one-click 'Reteach briefing' that generates a short explanation script plus 2-3 worked examples for the teacher to use at the board — separate from, and alongside, the student-facing practice set that already gets generated.
